reuse.why: shared/schedules.ts already exports getScheduledAmount, which decides exactly missing/number/range-furthest-from-zero and is used by forecast, schedules app and budget templates, but the diff re-writes it inline.

duplication.why: The null, number and `Math.abs(num1) >= Math.abs(num2)` endpoint rule are duplicated from getScheduledAmount inside scheduleModel.toExternal.

placement.why: Adding the field in scheduleModel.toExternal in api-models.ts is the right layer, and the input types correctly omit the derived field.

scope.why: Only the API model, its input types and a focused test change.

maintainability.why: A future change to the expected-amount rule in getScheduledAmount will silently not reach the API copy.

bypasses_abstraction.where: api-models.ts scheduleModel.toExternal computes expectedAmount itself instead of calling shared/schedules getScheduledAmount(schedule._amount).

disguised_duplication.where: getScheduledAmount's if-chain is reshaped into a nested ternary inline in scheduleModel.toExternal.
